projects.name: MedTracker
projects.overview: Secure healthcare platform with AI-powered medical document understanding for automated PDF parsing and structured extraction.
features: Express + MongoDB REST API (36 endpoints, 7 models) with dual JWT / Google OAuth
Cache-aside Redis hot cache, MongoDB source of truth, 30-day TTL, AI analysis once per record
Automatic LLaMA → Gemini fallback with fail-open
projects.architecture: Next.js frontend, Express REST APIs, MongoDB, JWT+OAuth 2.0, Redis cache-aside, LLaMA/Gemini extraction pipeline.
projects.problem: Medical records and documents are scattered across formats, making them hard to manage, search, and understand for healthcare teams.
projects.motivation: Healthcare information is often buried in PDFs and unstructured documents. Nivi wanted to build a system that could automatically extract structured medical data from documents and make it reliable and searchable.
challenges: Balancing dual AI models (LLaMA → Gemini) with fail-open behavior
Maintaining cache-aside consistency between Redis and MongoDB
Handling dual authentication (JWT + Google OAuth) across 36 endpoints
Ensuring AI analysis runs exactly once per record
projects.results: 36 REST endpoints across 7 models, 21 automated tests, dual JWT/OAuth authentication, Redis cache-aside with 30-day TTL, sub-second response times, fail-open AI pipeline.
projects.learnings: Fail-open AI pipelines and cache-aside patterns are essential for production healthcare systems where model reliability and data freshness matter.

projects.name: CardioVision
projects.impact: End-to-end clinical AI pipeline for coronary artery stenosis detection
projects.overview: Clinical AI pipeline for stenosis detection/segmentation using YOLOv8 trained on 1,500 ARCADE angiography images.
projects.architecture: Dual YOLOv8 models wrapped in FastAPI, OpenCV preprocessing, Grad-CAM heatmaps, JSON responses.
projects.metrics: 94.4% mAP@0.5 · 0.91 F1 · Sub-200ms latency · Saved 7+ hrs dataset prep
projects.problem: Coronary artery stenosis detection from angiography images is a critical clinical task requiring high accuracy and explainability.
projects.motivation: Cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death; automated detection from angiography could save time and improve diagnostic accuracy.
challenges: Converting COCO annotations to YOLO format
Benchmarking multiple YOLOv8 variants for clinical accuracy
Integrating Grad-CAM for model explainability
Handling 1,500 labeled angiography images
projects.results: 94.4% mAP@0.5, 0.91 F1-score, sub-200ms inference latency, saved 7+ hours of dataset preparation.
projects.learnings: Explainability (Grad-CAM) is critical for clinical AI — clinicians need to understand why a model makes a prediction, not just that it is accurate.

projects.name: Chat Constellation
projects.impact: Graph-native AI chat platform replacing linear history with conversational graphs
projects.overview: Graph-native AI chat platform replacing linear history with interactive conversational graphs.
projects.architecture: React + React Flow, Express API, MongoDB, OpenAI API, JWT, Dockerized.
projects.problem: Traditional chat interfaces use linear conversation history, making it hard to explore non-linear thought threads.
projects.motivation: Conversations are naturally non-linear — ideas branch and connect. A graph-based interface better mirrors how people think and work.
challenges: Real-time graph persistence in MongoDB
Cascading account deletion with cleanup
Context-aware OpenAI interactions across graph nodes
Supporting concurrent multi-threaded exploration
projects.results: React Flow graph visualization, real-time thread persistence, JWT + Google OAuth, supports 10+ concurrent users, Dockerized deployment.
projects.learnings: Graph-native architectures provide better conversation navigation than linear history, especially for complex multi-threaded work.

projects.name: AI Product Review Analyzer
projects.impact: Fully serverless NLP analytics pipeline for review understanding
projects.overview: Serverless NLP analytics pipeline for large-scale review sentiment + key-phrase extraction.
projects.architecture: API Gateway → Lambda → Comprehend → DynamoDB → CloudWatch. Serverless, IAM-controlled.
projects.problem: Analyzing large volumes of product reviews for sentiment and key phrases at scale is expensive and complex.
projects.motivation: A fully serverless pipeline could scale automatically without idle infrastructure costs, processing reviews in real-time via event-driven architecture.
challenges: 4-class sentiment classification with high accuracy
Real-time event-driven processing
Maintaining serverless architecture with proper IAM controls
CloudWatch monitoring for pipeline health
projects.results: Zero idle infrastructure cost, fully serverless deployment, independent component scaling, automated review classification and insights extraction.
projects.learnings: Serverless architectures with event-driven patterns eliminate idle costs but require careful IAM and monitoring design.

projects.name: Linux System Monitor & Automation Suite
projects.impact: Lightweight infra monitoring for automated Linux health tracking
projects.overview: Lightweight infra monitoring for automated health tracking via Bash + Cron.
projects.architecture: Bash scripts via Cron, AWK/Grep parsing, timestamped logs.
projects.problem: Manual system health checks are time-consuming and error-prone for infrastructure monitoring.
projects.motivation: Automated health tracking using lightweight Bash and Cron tools could eliminate repetitive manual checks and provide reliable threshold alerts.
challenges: Configuring threshold alerts for resource utilization
Implementing log compression and automated cleanup via Cron
Parsing diverse metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network) with AWK/Grep
projects.results: Automated collection of 6+ infrastructure metrics, eliminated repetitive manual health checks, configurable threshold alerting.
projects.learnings: Simple Bash+Cron solutions can be surprisingly effective for infrastructure automation without heavy tooling.

projects.name: Security Event Collection & Analysis Agent
projects.impact: Linux security agent for centralized auth event collection
projects.overview: Lightweight security agent for auth/audit event collection with SIEM-ready JSON.
projects.architecture: Python pipeline parsing auth/audit logs via regex → JSON forwarding.
projects.problem: Auth and audit log events are scattered across systems, making centralized security monitoring difficult.
projects.motivation: Centralized, SIEM-ready event collection enables faster incident response and audit compliance.
challenges: Parsing Linux auth/audit logs with regex reliably
Ensuring sub-2-second forwarding latency
Maintaining structured JSON output for SIEM tools
projects.results: Processed 100+ daily authentication events, sub-2-second event forwarding latency, SIEM-ready JSON output, eliminated manual log inspection workflows.
projects.learnings: Regex-based log parsing can produce structured, forwardable security events without complex infrastructure.
